'''2013 Worlds Day 1 Stephen Cellucci LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Cellucci]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion]]
* '''Username:''' Nolimit
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
